working_definition: Author cell type 'peripheral glial cell' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult leg, wing, proboscis and palps, 1788 cells): glia of the peripheral nervous system. Authors' term FBbt:00001327 is obsolete (replaced by PNS glial cell, FBbt:00001320).
searches_performed: authors' ontology id FBbt:00001327 (obsolete; replaced_by FBbt:00001320)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any PNS glial cell of the adult.

justification: The authors' term is obsolete; its replacement is PNS glial cell, and the data are adult so the adult variant is preferred.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Glial cell that is part of the peripheral nervous system.

recommendation: Map to adult PNS glial cell.
